shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin and altcoins have fallen 5-7% due to broad market liquidations.
Markets are pricing in a 70-79% probability of a 25 basis point Federal Reserve rate hike in December due to persistent inflation concerns.
Concerns over potential tighter US crypto regulations and recent Bitcoin ETF outflows are impacting market sentiment.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index currently indicates a 'Neutral' sentiment, despite recent price declines.
